jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview
  
  

Vinova is an award\-winning development company specializing in mobile, web, and enterprise applications. Since 2010, it has delivered quality projects globally in IoT, blockchain, fintech, banking, networking, and ecommerce, fostering innovation through passion and collaboration.
  
  

Job Summary
  
  

As a Full\-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and user\-centric web applications that enable AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions for government systems and digital services.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for frontend interfaces
  
  

Build backend services and APIs using Java/Spring Boot, .NET (C\#), or equivalent technologies to support scalable and secure applications
  
  

Apply programming skills in Python to develop and enhance software components and automation scripts
  
  

Deploy and manage applications in cloud environments such as AWS, GCC, or other approved enterprise cloud platforms to ensure reliability and scalability
  
  

Use GitLab or similar version control tools to manage source code, implement CI/CD pipelines, and enforce secure development workflows
  
  

Collaborate with product, policy, data, cybersecurity, DevOps, platform, and business teams to translate operational needs into production\-ready digital solutions
  
  

Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and performance issues through strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
  
  

Proactively engage in continuous learning and apply modern web, cloud, and AI\-enabled technologies to improve agency and citizen services
  
  

Preferred competencies and qualifications
  
  

Experience working on Singapore Government projects or within public sector agencies
  
  

Interest and ability to integrate AI, machine learning, and generative AI technologies into web applications
  
  

Self\-motivated and resourceful with strong software engineering fundamentals and full\-stack development experience
  
  

Established in 2010, Vinova is a passion\-driven and award\-winning development company for mobile, web, and enterprise applications. Our clients span the globe and cover a wide range of projects including IoT, blockchain, banking, fintech, networking, and ecommerce.
  
  

Vinova earns respect from customers by being committed to quality, flexibility, and speed. We strive to build great products by working with a passion, working closely with our customers, and through open but disciplined collaboration.
  
  

You will be working in an encouraging and challenging environment, taking advantage of the latest technology to develop excellent mobile apps for clients. You will be engaging clients in both on\-site and off\-site support.
  
  

Interested to join our all\-star team? Submit your application to us now! Tell us why you want to work with us and why you think you’d be a good candidate. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Java Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack Java Engineer
Location:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Work Setting:
Hybrid – 3 days in office / 2 days from home
Employment Type:
Full-time
Industry:
Technology / Online Delivery
Function:
Software Engineering / Full Stack Development
About the Role
Seeking a Senior Fullstack Java Engineer to help modernise partner technology and build scalable, event-driven microservices using Java, Spring and Kubernetes.
Key Responsibilities
Design and build scalable, event-driven microservices.
Translate product requirements into technical solutions and API/event contracts.
Develop clean, maintainable code and mentor junior developers.
Maintain and modernise legacy .NET applications.
Troubleshoot production issues and improve platform reliability.
Explore AI-driven tools and emerging technologies to improve development efficiency.
Collaborate across engineering and product teams.

Requirements
Strong Java/Spring or C#/.NET experience with microservices and design patterns.
Full-stack development experience with React, Vue or similar.
Hands-on AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and CI/CD experience.
Experience with Kafka, AWS SNS/SQS and relational/NoSQL databases.
Knowledge of testing frameworks such as JUnit and Testcontainers.
Experience with distributed tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry or Datadog.
Familiarity with PHP and cybersecurity practices.
Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills.

Location requirement:
Amsterdam, with 3 days per week in the office.

jobs.title: Software Developer - Java/C#
jobs.description:
Ready for your next challenge as a Fullstack or Backend Developer in Java, C#, or .NET?
ALTEN is looking for an experienced Fullstack or Backend Developer to join our team in Gothenburg and work with cutting-edge projects for our clients in the automotive industries. This is a hybrid role where you’ll design, develop, and maintain robust applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

What do we offer?
At ALTEN, we believe in fostering an environment where your skills and ambitions thrive. Here’s what you can expect:
Work on innovative solutions for industry-leading clients.
Access to continuous learning and career development opportunities.
Join a team of passionate engineers and experts.
Attractive salary, wellness programs, and more

About the role
As a Fullstack or Backend Developer, you will play a key role in developing and optimizing applications using Java, C#, or .NET. You’ll work closely with architects, product owners, and other developers to deliver high-quality software solutions. Your expertise in modern development practices and cloud technologies will be essential in driving projects forward.
You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and DevOps practices (Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD) will be highly valued.

Your main responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using Java, C#, or .NET.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement software solutions.
Optimize application performance and ensure high availability.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployments.
Work with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) to deploy and manage applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.

Your profile
You are a skilled Fullstack or Backend Developer with a passion for creating robust and scalable applications.
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Java, C#, or .NET development.
Proficiency in Java, C#, or .NET, with experience in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and DevOps tools (Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD) being a plus.
Experience in the automotive industry is meritorious.

Please note, this is a proactive job advertisement intended to connect with talented professionals and does not currently refer to a specific assignment. We review applications continuously. However, due to the summer holiday period, the processing time may be longer than usual. Applications will be reviewed towards the end of August.

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the sixth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

Please be aware that applications submitted via email or direct messaging will not be considered.

For any HR-related questions or request regarding a job application, please select the ‘Recruitment’ category in “Contact us”.
